component.name: SPACE Tasks
component.summary: Plan your day with tasks, a PDF reader and on-device AI

description.p: SPACE Tasks is a free productivity app that keeps everything on your computer. Its AI assistant, OCR and translation run locally, so there are no subscriptions, no ads and no tracking.

ul.li: Tasks with workspaces, priorities, a calendar and progress statistics
A PDF library with local OCR and translation in seven languages
An AI assistant that runs on your GPU; your questions never reach an AI provider
Lo-fi loops for focus, plus your own music
Password-protected accounts with version history, recovery and automatic backups

description.p: The interface is available in English, Spanish, Portuguese, French, German, Italian and Japanese. Models for translation and the assistant are downloaded the first time you use those features.
